speaker: Sunita
text: Good morning Papa ji, here is your morning ginger tea with no sugar.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Sunita ji, did Dr. Mehta visit yesterday? What did he say about his diet?

speaker: Sunita
text: Dr. Mehta said Papa must strictly avoid sugar, sweets, and pastries.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Okay, please ensure no sugar in his tea or meals.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Also, the weather looks cloudy today outside.

speaker: Aarav
text: Dadu, my cricket bat grip came loose.

speaker: Ramesh
text: I will fix the grip tonight, Aarav.

speaker: Sunita
text: Papa ji, it is 6 PM. Let us go for our evening walk in the park.

speaker: Ramesh
text: The municipal water bill has arrived in the mail today.

speaker: Sunita
text: Yes bhaiya, the water bill is due this week before Friday.

speaker: Ramesh
text: I will pay the water bill online from my office account.

speaker: Sunita
text: Oh Papa ji dropped his reading glasses and the frame is cracked.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Let me take Papa's reading glasses to the optical shop for repair.

speaker: Sunita
text: The optician said the specs will take four days to repair.

speaker: Neighbor
text: Hello Ramesh, did you see the traffic on the main road?

speaker: Ramesh
text: Yes, construction is still going on.

speaker: Priya
text: Hello Bhaiya! Calling from Pune. How is Papa doing today?

speaker: Ramesh
text: He is good Priya. When are you coming down to visit?

speaker: Priya
text: I booked my bus ticket. Priya is visiting Papa on Sunday morning.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Great! Mohan Papa will be thrilled to see you on Sunday.

speaker: Priya
text: Should I bring anything special? Maybe a bakery cake?

speaker: Ramesh
text: No! Dr. Mehta strictly forbade sugar and sweets for Papa.

speaker: Priya
text: Understood, no cake or sweets for Sunday then. I will bring sugar-free fruits.

speaker: Sunita
text: Papa ji, your blue shawl is freshly washed and folded on your chair.

speaker: Sunita
text: The physiotherapist called. The physio session is moved to Thursday at 11 AM.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Good to know, Thursday 11 AM physio is noted.

speaker: Aarav
text: Dadu, my school cricket tournament match is this Saturday morning!

speaker: Sunita
text: Aarav has been practicing cricket all week.

speaker: Ramesh
text: We will all cheer for Aarav on Saturday.

speaker: Sunita
text: Papa ji enjoys listening to the vintage radio after lunch.

speaker: Ramesh
text: I checked the radio batteries, they have full charge.

speaker: Sunita
text: Bhaiya, remember Tuesday morning is temple visit with Mohan Papa.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Yes, we visit Hanuman temple every Tuesday morning without fail.

speaker: Ramesh
text: I also checked with the optician, reading glasses repair will be done by Friday.

speaker: Sunita
text: Papa has been having trouble reading the newspaper without his glasses.

speaker: Delivery
text: Grocery package delivery for Sharma residence.

speaker: Sunita
text: Thank you, I will take the pulses and oats.

speaker: Sunita
text: Today is Thursday, physiotherapist will be here at 11 AM.

speaker: Physiotherapist
text: Mohan ji, your arm mobility is improving nicely after the stroke.

speaker: Physiotherapist
text: Keep doing the gentle shoulder rotations twice a day.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Sunita, did you confirm Priya is arriving on Sunday morning?

speaker: Sunita
text: Yes, beti Priya will reach by 10 AM on Sunday.

speaker: Sunita
text: And remember Papa: at 6 PM we take our walk to the park.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Good morning Papa! I paid the water bill online earlier today.

speaker: Sunita
text: The optician called, the reading glasses are finally ready for pickup.

speaker: Ramesh
text: I will pick up the reading glasses on my way back from work.

speaker: Aarav
text: Dadu, don't forget my cricket match tomorrow morning!

speaker: Sunita
text: Sunita will make sure Dadu wears his blue shawl if it feels chilly.

speaker: Ramesh
text: Priya called again, reminding us she is arriving Sunday morning.
